data.strFullDescription:
[p]有了序章，你就能体验到《Mall Simulator》的入门级内容和功能。别忘了添加到您的收藏夹，并关注我们，以获取完整版游戏。
[imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3502270/extras/c6d6fd240063b46469ca74ef1db49ac1.poster.avif?t=1761840450" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3502270/extras/c6d6fd240063b46469ca74ef1db49ac1.webm?t=1761840450" width="800" height="144"][/imgvid]
[/p][p][b]Mall Simulator 是一个轻松的第一人称模拟游戏，在这里你将体验成为一个大型购物中心的老板，经营多家不同的商店。 
[/b][/p][p][img width="800" height="101"]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3502270/extras/982078ee35bc6d7359c45d948700ff02.avif?t=1761840450[/img]设计很重要！为你的购物中心打造最佳设计并管理你的商店。展示你的畅销店铺，为顾客打造完美的购物中心。

[imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3502270/extras/37eeae65d6b3464ec5efc16593df5b7b.poster.avif?t=1761840450" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3502270/extras/37eeae65d6b3464ec5efc16593df5b7b.webm?t=1761840450" width="748" height="420"][/imgvid]
[/p][p][img width="800" height="101"]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3502270/extras/f817696ab744f7ac2d68bad695342d99.avif?t=1761840450[/img]从零到英雄！在你的购物中心开设最知名品牌的新店，销售他们的产品。从杂货店到珠宝店，不断扩展你的商店种类。

[imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3502270/extras/55ddfd6444237d33b76b3d415003d410.poster.avif?t=1761840450" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3502270/extras/55ddfd6444237d33b76b3d415003d410.webm?t=1761840450" width="748" height="420"][/imgvid]
[/p][p][img width="800" height="101"]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3502270/extras/b5d24cd55cd6d6da37941599d5ca1d83.avif?t=1761840450[/img]缺货了？及时补充新产品，紧跟潮流，确保顾客留在你的购物中心。

[imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3502270/extras/4c48eed1f6dfcb1bee595b64abbd9c0b.poster.avif?t=1761840450" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3502270/extras/4c48eed1f6dfcb1bee595b64abbd9c0b.webm?t=1761840450" width="748" height="420"][/imgvid]
[/p][p][img width="800" height="101"]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3502270/extras/0eae0ddea55ff8c574b00e3722235f5f.avif?t=1761840450[/img]时间就是金钱！你的购物中心可能会很繁忙，快速收款并雇用新员工，避免让顾客等待。 

[imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3502270/extras/50443e9f5c79e6ca22e7a85350f1c979.poster.avif?t=1761840450" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3502270/extras/50443e9f5c79e6ca22e7a85350f1c979.webm?t=1761840450" width="750" height="422"][/imgvid]
[/p][p][img width="800" height="101"]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3502270/extras/b7d4bff74d65127ef091d5c1e5387c69.avif?t=1761840450[/img]打破墙壁！开辟新空间，为你的购物中心带来更多商店和品牌。 

[imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3502270/extras/bf17e6d5350077822e76a5fe2be47b82.poster.avif?t=1761840450" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3502270/extras/bf17e6d5350077822e76a5fe2be47b82.webm?t=1761840450" width="744" height="418"][/imgvid]
[/p][p][/p][p] 
[/p][p][b]在《Mall Simulator》中，顾客满意度至关重要。你需要紧跟潮流，开设新店，设定合理的价格，并扩大购物中心，以避免破产。[/b][/p]
data.strSnippet: 将您的商店从一个小型购物中心变成一个巨大的城市购物中心！现在就开始与 Prologue 合作。为了避免破产，您需要谈判新的店铺交易、制定合理的价格并紧跟潮流。Prologue 的商店和产品数量有限，恭候您的光临。
